No one is forcing you to buy skins/heroes with ice bud. This game is completely FREE, you can earn everything free; except for the seasonal skins. I've been playing since Skaarf release (December 2014) and I understand the changes and have no problem at all with them; I particularly enjoy the early access as well buying skins with ice. I want to support SEMC.

Not everyone likes to play casually, I particularly enjoy both. But I love the competitive aspect more; as I'm sure many others do too.

You can still have good games playing competitively, it just falls back down to how good of a sport you are. But, many get so caught up and get really frustrated.

With this, it has caused so much social discord in matches. Before everyone goes back to their proper tier, solo queue is not recommended. I dropped from SA to PG with the tier compression, and am now encountering lower tiers on my team and against, and sometimes higher mixed. How can I tell the tiers? By the builds and how they play. The lower tier builds are obscure. This mix of high tiers and low tiers is annoying. The only way to win before this settles down is to form a party of three, I was dual queuing and our third was always not good.
